name: Digging Through the Dirt
summary: At Raven Hill Cemetery, you search for the Embalmer’s missing heart. A mound marked Eliza may hold the answer, buried beneath the dirt.

sections.title: A Grave Disturbed
sections.body: At Raven Hill Cemetery, one patch of loose soil bears the name Eliza. Other graves in Duskwood lie open to scavengers or feral ghouls, yet this earth was laid with care. Dig beneath the topsoil and you find splintered coffin boards. They cover the remnant the Embalmer meant to hide from daylight.

sections.title: The Scratching Within
sections.body: Eliza lies beneath splintered coffin boards, but she does not rest. The lid shudders as clawed fingers scrape and rotting jaws clatter. Abercrombie’s experiment stirs inside her pine coffin. The Embalmer’s missing heart beats in her breast as she waits for unwary hands to open the grave.

faq.q: What is buried in Eliza's grave?
faq.answer: A coffin lies beneath the dirt, holding Eliza, an undead creature made by the Embalmer. His heart rests in her breast.
Eliza’s grave lies in Raven Hill Cemetery in western Duskwood, among haunted crypts and roaming undead.

faq.q: Why do you have to dig into the coffin?
faq.answer: You dig into the grave to face Eliza and recover the Embalmer’s heart. That ends the search for his foul schemes.

faq.q: What happens when the coffin is opened?
faq.answer: When you open the coffin, Eliza breaks free. You must destroy the clawing ghoul to recover the heart sealed inside with her.

faq.q: Who put Eliza in the ground?
faq.answer: The Embalmer buried Eliza in Raven Hill Cemetery, hiding his creation and prized heart among its graves.

aliases: what kind of monster is eliza
faq.answer: Eliza was the Embalmer’s wife, raised by his dark magic with his heart in her breast. She is tougher and more deliberate than the mindless ghouls roaming Duskwood’s roads.

angles.text: Disturbing a fresh grave violates the funeral rites of the Holy Light. Releasing and destroying the unnatural fiend within cleanses the grave.
Clawing and gnashing beneath consecrated soil offend the peaceful rest the Light promises Duskwood’s dead.
The Night Watch struggles against the terror spilling from Raven Hill. Finding the horrors the Embalmer buried is vital to Darkshire’s safety.
